text:
Ana: Quick question — how do we want to structure PoC SKUs on the marketplace so they convert cleanly into committed private offers that include hardware partner credits? Need a simple runway for the field, low friction.
Matt: My +1 is a time-limited PoC SKU (30 days) with a fixed usage credit and an explicit "Convert to Commit" flow. Track via a meter_id so we can reconcile usage.
Jess: Agree. Also add a staged discount ladder on conversion (e.g., 30% initial credit, 15% on year 1 commit, then baseline price). Keeps conversation simple with customers.
Rohit: Reconciliation note — marketplaces refund mechanics are messy. We should implement invoice-offset crediting internally instead of refunds where possible. Need clear mapping from meter_id -> internal account.
Claire: Legal: do NOT auto-convert. Customer must opt-in. Also we need a clause for expired HW credits (what happens if SI doesn't deliver serials).
Matt: Example SKU config (proposal):
```json
{"sku":"RID-POC-30d","meter_id":"mkt-POC-9821","credit_usd":"5000","convert_url":"https://console.redwood.example/convert?poc=mkt-POC-9821","duration_days":30}
```
Ana: Nice. Can PartnerBot create a draft private offer when the customer clicks convert and populate partner credit line items? @PartnerBot
PartnerBot: Draft private offer created -> PO-2134 (draft). Linked acct: ACME. UI link: https://console.redwood.example/po/2134 :package: 
Jess: Onboarding play: require SI integration check + hardware serial claim within 45 days or credits expire. Field team to do a quick health check before full commit.
Rohit: For billing flow: when convert happens, create a proforma invoice with credit lines, then when partner hardware is verified mark credits applied. If marketplace already billed, do internal offset. Add reconciler job that runs weekly.
Claire: Renewal trigger idea: if customer uses >=60% of committed volume for 2 consecutive months, auto-suggest renewal with a one-click accept in console (still opt-in). Also route to Partner AE for co-sell.
Ana: Need telemetry: a dashboard for PoC -> commit funnel (clicks, conversions, HW verification rate). Ops: fields to track: meter_id, convert_ts, po_id, hw_serial_count, credit_applied_flag.
Matt: I can spec the SKU and meter mapping. Will include metrics naming. Pinging @Jess and @Rohit for inputs.
Jess: I'll draft the onboarding checklist and the 45-day HW claims step.
Rohit: I'll prototype the reconciler job and invoice offset mapping.
Claire: I'll add the legal opt-in and expired-credit language.
Ana: Awesome. Action owners: Matt -> SKU spec, Jess -> onboarding, Rohit -> billing/reconciler, Claire -> legal. Sync back EOD Friday for PR review.
Matt: Will open a PR with the SKU schema and sample meter IDs, cc @Jess @Rohit.
Jess: ack :thumbsup:
PartnerBot: PO-2134 status updated -> pending-acceptance
Ana: Thanks all — this feels like a good low-friction path for PoCs to convert and keep partner credits clean.
